duration_rationale: This is the one calendar-triggered follow-up after a complete 1205-second zero-event capture. Five minutes is sufficient to detect a newly recurrent public flow while limiting repeated ticker retention and operator time; a second null cannot justify another daily poll.
question: After the literal nonoverlapping retry boundary, has public BTCUSDT, ETHUSDT, or SOLUSDT Spot block-trade flow become recurrent enough to expose at least three exact events and a strictly positive after-block-fee price-concession lower bound against a causal pre-trade public quote?

economics.why_lower_bound: For the same positive quantity, the average public-book buy price cannot be below the contemporaneous best ask and the average public-book sell price cannot be above the contemporaneous best bid. Positive value remains only a public execution lead, not proof of access, causality, recurrence, or future profitability.

terminal_gates.transport_complete: The connection remains valid until 300 seconds or three block trades; any earlier close consumes and fails the capture.
terminal_gates.analyzable_row: Exact documented identities and positive numeric values plus a prior causal ticker no more than 2000 ms old and a strictly uncrossed best bid and ask.
terminal_gates.material_follow_up_candidate: All three target block trades are analyzable and at least three distinct block IDs in one fixed symbol-and-side bucket have a strictly positive zero-public-fee lower-bound saving.

cumulative_adjudication: Combine elapsed time and exact event counts with the prior complete capture only for a descriptive public recurrence screen; never pool prices across noncontemporaneous windows or infer private accessibility.
retry_policy: This exact connection is one-use. If it completes with fewer than three qualifying same-symbol-and-side observations, prohibit further time-only public observations before 2026-09-06T03:47:16.3134381Z and require a material official stream, fee, pair, whitelist, settlement, block-volume, or observed public-event change for any earlier reopening. A transport failure may not be repaired under this contract.
prohibited: historicalBlockTrades without its required MARKET_DATA authority
